featured_reviews.name: Divya Ravichandran
featured_reviews.review_text:
I think I'm the biggest fan of Annie's Signature Pudding Tart. I've eaten a lot of cakes but Annie's Signature Pudding Tart is the best in the world. It goes to the heart! She does a lot of variations & flavours, she tops the tart with Berries, strawberries, mango, etc, but my favourite is the original one with hazelnuts. I usually buy this cake for any and every occasion and fortunately my friends, family, work folks all have loved it so much that repeating this cake only creates excitement. I think there are times when we end up celebrating the cake instead of the occasion itself 😜. The mousse, the consistency of the tart its so yum and melts in the mouth. Just the thought of it  makes my mouth water. Annie's Jar's are also to die for. When there is no occasion and I want to casually take something to a visitor's house I do the Cake jars and that's a fantastic hit as well... I have so many friends who ask me to specially get the tart from Annie & only Annie, it's magic, I'm telling you it goes to the heart. If you haven't tried it as yet, arghh pls do yourself a favour and order one now. While Annie has been kind to me, if you plan to order a cake from her, please order in advance, her slots get full very fast!
Thanks Annie for always accomodating me and giving me your best cakes to relish! ❤️

They were quite generous with their sample size and provided us multiple options to choose from. We finally zeroed down on the Hazelnut & Cadbury cake. We requested them to deliver the cake at a time closer to midnight and they did not disappoint. Very professional and courteous staff.

Our guests and the birthday girl alike loved the cake and couldn't stop clicking pictures of it until they got busy with eating it. The cake was tender and had just the right amount of sweetness.  It was undoubtedly one of the best cakes I have had in my life.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Bate
featured_reviews.review_text: I ordered Whole wheat Sourdough bread from Ovenfresh, Dadar west on 24/2/2026 on Swiggy. But when I received this bread, I was shocked to see that there was a hole in the bottom of one side of this bread and the bottom 4 loaves had been gnawed. The way the bread was gnawed, it looked like it had been gnawed by a mouse. It is very sad and shameful that such contaminated food is being distributed from a store like Ovenfresh.

featured_reviews.name: R
featured_reviews.review_text:

The pretentious quantity of food doesmt even justify the exorbitant pricing. First and my last time here.

featured_reviews.name: Neha Rege
featured_reviews.review_text:
Oven Fresh Dadar used to be one of my favorite places, which is why this visit was especially disappointing. We were a group of 6 and were given an extremely cramped table with barely enough space to sit comfortably. The place was also so loud that it was difficult to even have a proper conversation.

The service was honestly pathetic. The staff was very rude and completely uninterested in helping us. No one was responsive to our table, and we had to repeatedly ask for basic things like menus and service. At one point we literally had to call the restaurant’s phone number just to get someone to bring us the menu.

The food itself tasted good, but the quantity felt surprisingly little for the price. Also the pastry we ordered did not seem fresh at all - it felt old and dry instead of soft and fresh.

Really sad to see the experience go downhill because Oven Fresh was genuinely one of my go-to places earlier.
